_source: DeliveryBadgeService — the exact thresholds it promotes on — and BadgeLevel.java. Pay is not here: a rider is paid the order's whole delivery fee (fees.json, _rider). Documents: VerificationGateService, which computes the list from the vehicle.
_why: A rider deciding whether to sign up wants two numbers: what a drop pays, and what changes if they stick around. Both exist in the platform and neither is usually published.

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.detail: Where every partner starts. Full access to jobs from day one.

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.detail: Consistency starts to count — a steady record moves you up.

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.detail: A record built over months, not a good week.

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.detail: Top tier. Highest priority when a job is being assigned.

_ratingNote: A rating that dips below a threshold does not demote automatically — that is an administrator's decision, not a nightly job.
_vehicles: VehicleType.java. VerificationGateService.MOTORISED = BIKE, SCOOTER, AUTO, CNG_AUTO — a bicycle is the one that is not.

documents._note: A bicycle owes no licence, RC or plate — the state issues none for one. Three vehicle photographs, because one proves a photograph was taken and three prove it is the vehicle claimed. A bank account or a UPI id is required before documents are even looked at; either one is enough.
documents._plate: NUMBER_PLATE is not an upload: the plate is declared on the profile, required of a motorised vehicle and never of a bicycle.
